intro: Award-winning educational party fun for the whole family.
description:
The Ultimate Game Night for Learning and Laughter

Play solo against AI or locally with up to 4 players on the same Nintendo Switch™ system. Educational Family Games is designed for people playing together in the same room and does not include online multiplayer.

From the creators of the award-winning Educational Games for Kids comes a collection of 80 quick games across 5 interactive game boards, combining educational challenges with party-game fun for the whole family.

Race, think, remember, solve, guess, react, and compete in challenges involving math, geography, logic, memory, reflexes, science, chemistry, art, anatomy, entertaining party games, and timeless classics. Collect gems, buy crowns, and try to finish as the winner.

One moment you may be solving math problems under pressure. The next, you may be dodging fireballs, racing bicycles, flying rockets, scoring goals, copying drawings, or competing in chaotic 2-versus-2 challenges. Every quick game offers something different.

Every instruction, word, and character is fully voiced in 19 languages. No reading is required, making the game accessible to pre-readers, grandparents, and players of different abilities.

Key Features

• Solo play against AI or local multiplayer for 1–4 players
• 80 educational and party quick games
• 5 interactive game boards
• Math, geography, logic, memory, science, chemistry, art, anatomy, reflexes, and more
• Fully voiced in 19 languages
• AI fills empty player positions
• Short sessions or longer family tournaments
• 10 playable characters
• Colorful 2D cartoon visuals
• Family-friendly and violence-free
• No online multiplayer

Designed for children, parents, grandparents, friends, parties, holidays, and living-room game nights. Suitable for ages 5 to 100.
